title: EHR Downtime — Patient Data Leak on Actor's Site

transcript.speaker: ISO
transcript.text: Helen, Marcus Hale. The managed detection service just confirmed it: our name is on a leak site. The actor posted a sample of 40 patient face sheets — names, DOBs, medical record numbers — all from 2024. The clock is counting down 71 hours. We’ve verified the sample. It’s real.

transcript.speaker: AOC
transcript.text: Confirmed, Marcus. The CPO must start the HIPAA risk assessment immediately. This is a presumptive breach under 45 CFR 164.402. We’ll convene the Policy Group now.

transcript.speaker: ISO
transcript.text: Understood. I’m notifying the CPO and the outside counsel. The PIO should begin drafting a statement, but not release it yet.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the attacker has exfiltrated PHI. The ISO must initiate the CPO’s risk assessment; the CPO must begin the HIPAA breach process. The AOC and outside counsel must initiate the Policy Group call. The PIO must prepare but not issue a public statement.
